assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. For the actual isometric mobile game Dungeon Empire, author ONE high quality isolated sprite/material on TRUE transparent alpha, crisp edge and transparent margins on all four sides. Image 1 is the approved in-game chest: MATCH its clean painterly charcoal edge, graphic bevels, dark violet-blue ambient, cool upper-left highlights, simple readable masses at tiny native sprite sizes. Image 2 is the exact UI currency icon: its lozenge in a polygonal gold rim, strong brass/ochre contrast, sparse light glints, dark purple underside are canonical. Image 3 is only an old composition and fixed camera reference, DO NOT imitate its mottled photoreal coins or clay-looking bags. No text, HUD, logo, frame, prop base or torch. Paint ONE soft CLOSED money bag in a three-quarter isometric camera with 30 degree elevation (ground projects 2:1), ground-supported. Asymmetric squat slouching pear silhouette with flat weighted bottom, gathered neck, visibly cinched dark plum leather cord, two dangling ends with small bluish iron tips. Upper mouth folds collapse sideways. HAND-PAINTED rich plum-brown chestnut leather, clear broad creases, a short seam with 3 chunky stitches, a single small oxidized gunmetal clasp with muted violet inset. Soft bag shape, not a pot. Stylized hard-edged highlights and dark ink contour like image 1. No visible coins, no floor, no items around bag. Hero asset rendered legibly at just 40-55 pixels. Soft local contact shade only.
